stations.title: Bridie
stations.say: Can it keep the seats count?
stations.note: The clipboard is crossed out by noon.

stations.title: Seats left
stations.text: Counted by the program, all morning.

captions: Morning at the ticket hut. Bridie wants the program to keep the seats count.
Today the count is crossed out on the clipboard each time people board.
You keep the numbers and text in typed variables, in five small tasks.
Now the program counts the seats left after boarding and prints the fare.
Values with types and good names. The clipboard's numbers live in the program.
